senses.gloss:
हृत्, त्, त्, त् (at the end of comps.), taking away,
removing, carrying off, seizing, &c.

हृत, अस्, आ, अम्, taken, taken away, seized;
captivated; accepted; (अम्), n. that which is taken;
a portion, share.
—हृत-चन्द्र, अस्, आ, अम्, having
the moon taken away; destitute of moon, moon-
less.
—हृत-ज्ञान, अस्, आ, अम्, bereft of knowledge,
void of knowledge.
—हृत-द्रव्य, अस्, आ, अम्,
stripped of everything, deprived of one's property.
—हृत-धन, अस्, आ, अम्, spoiled of wealth.
—हृत-प्रसाद, अस्, आ, अम्, deprived of calmness.
[]
—हृत-मानस, अस्, आ, अम्, deprived of mind,
robbed of one's senses.
—हृत-राज्य, अस्, आ, अम्,
stripped of a kingdom.
—हृत-वासस्, आस्, आस्, अस्,
whose dress is taken away, deprived of clothes.
—हृत-सर्वस्व, अस्, आ, अम्, robbed or stripped
of all personal property, entirely ruined.
—हृता-
धिकार (˚त-अध्˚), अस्, आ, अम्, deprived of an
office, turned out; deprived of one's right.
—हृ-
तोत्तर (˚त-उत्˚), अस्, आ, अम्, deprived of an answer,
left without a reply.
—हृतोत्तरीय (˚त-उत्˚), अस्,
आ, अम्, having the upper garments stripped off.
—हृतोरग (˚त-उर्˚), अस्, आ, अम्, deprived or
devoid of snakes.

हृति, इस्, f. taking away, seizure, robbing, rob-
bery; destruction.

हृत्वा, ind. having taken or seized, having ac-
cepted, &c.
